name: forgejo-issues
description: Browse the current repo's Forgejo or Gitea issues in a pane

apiUrl.title: API URL override
apiUrl.description: Base of the Forgejo API when it is not https://<remote host>/api/v1, for a remote whose SSH host differs from its web host. Leave empty to derive it from the git remote.

pageSize.title: Issues per page
pageSize.description: How many issues one request lists (Forgejo caps it at 50 by default)
